title: Float Sword
text: “Alright, let’s move out! Dadada! Onward, I say!”
The way forward lies ahead, indeed! And as I pressed onward, the boss that appeared was…
“Gau gau!”

A giant balloon named Unstable, I say. I’d assumed a balloon-type boss would be something like a King Balloon, but apparently not. First things first, I needed to check whether I could Character Change. And yes, I could.
“Then let’s change to Itsuki, I say!”
I swapped over to Itsuki with a flash. The Character Change happened instantly, indeed.
“Looks like we can Character Change even during a boss fight, Ren-san.”
Itsuki must have wanted to test this too, since he fired off an arrow as a preemptive strike before switching characters.
“Hey! Itsuki! Don’t just attack on your own!”
Ren, now the one in control, scolded Itsuki—at which point Father clapped his hands as if struck by realization.
“That’s another thing to verify. Whether you can Character Change mid-attack.”
“Fine, whatever… but by that logic, does this work too? Float Sword! Motoyasu!”

Ren summoned a floating sword with a flash and Character Changed. Now Ren’s floating sword was hovering right next to me. In my way, I say! Kachiin! I say! The sword struck Unstable right between the eyes and bounced back off.
“Why’d you deflect it and send it flying?!”
“Because it was in my way, I say!”
“So, Ren, you summoned a Float weapon and switched—how’s the control?”
“…Seems workable.”

The floating sword Ren had summoned spun through the air, spiraling toward Unstable. Don’t you dare steal my prey, I say! I immediately gave chase and unleashed Chaos Stab and Air Strike Javelin at Unstable.
“Take this, I say!”
“Gaaaaah!”

There was a solid hit, but it seemed one blow wouldn’t finish it off. This dungeon’s special rules were troublesome, indeed. Meanwhile, Ren’s floating sword, which had been spinning and slashing at Unstable, vanished with a flash after about thirty seconds.
“Guess weapons summoned via Change disappear after a time limit…”
“But it’s useful for moments when Naofumi-san needs to keep moving forward without fighting.”
“True. If I use remote control without fighting myself, I can use the floating sword too. Even with a time limit, it’s good to have the option.”
While they chatted away, I turned Unstable into a pincushion and finished it off, I say.
“Gaaaaaah——”
Unstable dissolved into light and vanished. Then some kind of glow seeped into one of our weapons. Looked like a drop item had appeared.
“Let’s see, the drop is a Royal Balloon Brooch. Equip effect: no longer targeted by balloons. Also causes a special effect during a Balloon’s Class Up…”
“Didn’t know there was an item like this.”
“Wasn’t in the game version, huh…”
“We’re not exactly raising balloons, you know? Guess we sell it or hand it to the kingdom for research?”
“Or maybe it’s simply the item used to turn something into that boss.”
Did that mean a regular balloon evolves into that boss? I wondered.
“Speaking of balloons, I recall one back in the village in the first world. Father ended up remodeling it into a Raph-species, I say.”
“Seriously, the very first Naofumi-san you knew sure loved Raphtalia-san way too much, huh.”
“I mean, Raph-chan is cute, sure—but I doted on Luna-chan plenty too.”
“Luna should just make do with Raph-species or Imiya.”
Ren was grumbling complaints about Luna-chan, I say! Luna-chan did nothing wrong, I say! It’s simply that Luna-chan’s strike zone happens to be Keel and Inult Ren, indeed!
“Oh, looks like there’s an additional effect for Class Ups besides just balloons.”
“Wonder what kind of effect. Sounds like a catalyst item for special Class Ups, like Filolials or dragons.”
“Imagine using it on a Filolial and it just puffs up and starts floating.”

If flying’s the goal, Fleon-chan’s right here, I say! And all Filolial-sama needs is Fleon-chan’s factor to fly, I say! That’s what I thought, but then I remembered—the Fiancée had mentioned hearing from Filo-tan that, back when Father was creating the Raph-species, he’d apparently tried to make Filo-tan float with gas, like a balloon. But what would that kind of flight even look like?
“Are the already-round Filolials gonna get even rounder and float?”
“Where’s this power-up item even from?”
“What’s wrong with being round and flying?”
Pata-pata went the sound of Rival’s wings, I say. Come to think of it, Rival is round too! HAHAHA!
“Naofumi, you don’t need to hold back on Rival’s account, nano.”
“Right. It’s not that it’s bad. Just figured there might be a gimmick like that, is all.”
“Filolial-sama shall not be made to fly looking like you, I say!”
“Say whatever you like, na~no~.”
Grr… Rival! It just brushed off my jab without a care, I say.
“Actually, since I’m a Peckul, if I equipped this, maybe I’d puff up and float too. There were retro games where penguins got fat and puffed up and floated, after all.”
Wh-what?! Was Father going to become round and float like a balloon?!
“Want to try equipping it and see, Naofumi-san?”
“Itsuki! Don’t use Father as your test subject, I say! If anything, you’re the one who should puff up your cheek pouches and fly, I say!”
I’ll be the one taking Father Balloon out for a stroll, I say!
“Kind of scary to think this could be a future gimmick… Oh, nope, doesn’t seem to have that particular effect.”
“What a shame. I won’t be puffing up my cheeks and flying!”
“Please don’t sound disappointed about that—you already self-destruct enough as it is…”
“Let’s change the subject. A balloon-type Filolial would probably move in some weird way.”
“Bouncing around all excited, probably.”
“Let’s table the ‘effective uses’ discussion and keep moving.”
“Right. Still, if we’re getting elements that strengthen allies too, I really wish we’d come here during a Wave period.”
“The experience points alone are great, honestly… this dungeon. Levels other than the Lantern one come pretty easily too.”

I defeated Unstable and pressed onward through the opening it left behind, I say. Meanwhile, Father and the others kept up their idle chatter. And where the path led wasn’t so much a fork as a difference in elevation. One side had a sheer vertical wall that made progress difficult. I tried stabbing my spear into the wall to climb, but the spear popped right back out the moment it stuck in—some strange wall that made climbing impossible. Jumping wasn’t enough height either. One more step up and it looked doable. If Father used Air Strike Shield, it felt like we could make a foothold and get across… The other path was just a normal walk.
“The higher route’s clearly the way to go, I say! Motoyasu, going in Flying Mode, I say!”
“Wait a second, Motoyasu!”
“Motoyasu-san! Not that way!”
Ren and Itsuki both called out warnings and stopped me right as I was about to leap up, Character Changing in the process.
“Whoa! I say!”
Itsuki was on the screen now.
“What is it, Itsuki?! Are you planning to steal my thunder and show off some elegant flying trick, I say?”
Was he intending to actually demonstrate that thing I’d told Yuki-chan about back when we arrived on this island? What a lofty ambition, I say.
“Who would do something like that?! That’s not it at all!”

“In first-time situations like this, when it looks like only one path is passable, going the straightforward route is the correct call. Gamer’s intuition is telling me. The iron rule is to cover the whole map!”

Ren and Itsuki were spouting some bizarre philosophy, I say. Was clearing the place really that important, to the point you had to explore every single path? Weren’t you two supposed to be focused on getting your original bodies back, I say?
“Somehow we’re all gamers at heart, huh.”
“Anyway, this way, this time.”
So saying, Itsuki strode off briskly—only to bump straight into some kind of transparent wall marked with a familiar carrot icon, I say. Beyond it, there seemed to be light shining from an altar.
